text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with Ethereum underperforming slightly, suggesting selective pressure on altcoins despite a relatively stable broader market. The Fear & Greed Index at 29 reflects genuine fear conditions, though the recent 4-point uptick hints at some stabilization sentiment. Bitcoin's dominance holding steady near 56.5% and $51B in daily volume indicate the market is functioning without panic liquidations, though conviction remains limited.
